steps.text: Check whether the length of text differs from 7 or any((c not in '0123456789' for c in text[:6])) or not ('a' is at most text[6] and is at most 'z'). Return False.
Set total to the sum of (int(d) * w for d, w in zip(text[:6], [1, 4, 3, 8, 5, 12])).
Map the weighted sum modulo 26 onto a–z and compare with the check letter.
